summary.text: Marc Berman, a Democrat, represents the 23rd Assembly District, which covers parts of San Mateo and Santa Clara counties, in the California State Assembly.

paragraphs.text: His official website says he was first elected in November 2016, previously served on the Palo Alto City Council, worked for the Silicon Valley Education Foundation, and was an attorney at Latham & Watkins LLP.

According to the same page, he was born in Dallas, raised in Palo Alto, studied political science at Georgetown University, earned a law degree at the University of Southern California, and lives in Menlo Park.
